title: Advanced Topics in Religious History; Sufism: Mystics in Islamic History
description:
Cross-listed with HIST429C. Credit only granted for HIST429C or RELS429A.

An exploration of the social and intellectual history of Sufism, the mystical tradition of Islam, from the 9th through the 20th centuries. Topics covered include key Sufi doctrines and practices, the formation and spread of Sufi paths (tariqas), Islamization, the relationship between popular religiosity and Sufism, and hagiography/sacred biography.
